notes.title: The V[B.2.1.9.ST]
notes.content:
Updates in the V[B.2.1.9.ST] release include:
1. Updated the battle algorithm. Fixed most of the previous bugs.
2. Updated the hover over tips during battle. Various skill effects can be displayed.
3. Improve the description of skills in the martial arts slots.
4. Added new superior A class martial arts: 14 Physical skills, 9 Agile skills, and 9 Energy skills. Once you have it, the game will change drastically.

notes.title: Full New Version 2.0
notes.content:
1. Battle
Added a visible difference between Limbo and Physical cards in fundamental battle.
Limbo Cards: Deal no damage, but can block opponent attacks.
Physical Cards: Cards that are drawn into your hand.
Regardless of whether cards have been drawn, players will not encounter situations where they have no cards to play.
 
2. Agile Effect Cards
We have added Agile effects.
Playing Agile effect cards allows players to see some cards the enemy has in hand.
The number of cards in hand changes according to the enemy's card plays. Players can use these circumstances to consider their next play.
 
3. Characters
Added 4 new characters.
There are a total of 8 male and female characters now.
Handheld weapon skins change according to Martial Arts.
Different attack effects are available.
 
4. Scenarios
Added 4 new scenarios.
Each scenario has had depth-of-field processing applied.
Added realism and variety.
 
5. Many more details have been added that await your discovery. We hope you will try and find more of them!

tags.feature: Added a visible difference between Limbo and Physical cards in fundamental battle.

notes.title: NEW UPDATE
notes.content:
In an effort to expedite development and to address player feedback, we are working overtime to update as much as we can. Our original plan for biweekly updates has now changed to weekly updates for the time being.

Version[B1.1.1.ST]
1.	Opened up the Steam achievement system.
There are currently 20 achievements.
Be rich
Have 10,000 coins.

Extravagance
Spend 9999 coins at one time in shop.

Chopper small scale
Slash the enemy for the first time.

The Warlin Rush
Slash the enemy three times in a row.

Budding
Get the first B-class Martial arts.

The A club
Get the first A-class Martial arts.

et ready
The first martial arts upgrade to level 10.

Candidate of The master of unique five
The first A-class martial arts upgrade to level 10.

Nice job
Defeat the enemies in the first 10 levels.

Break through
Defeat the enemies in the first 20 levels.

Unstoppable
Defeat the enemies in the first 30 levels.

Be a Hero
Defeat all enemies to complete the game.

Eager to learn
Collect 10 martial arts in one game.

Addicted to fighting
Collect 40 martial arts in one game.

The scenically beautiful place
Collect 80 martial arts in one game.

Veteran in Junlough
The Physical skill, Agile skill, and Energy skill of your equipment are all level 10.

From different teachers
Unlock the first extra martial arts slot.

Get through the two veins of Jen and Tu
Unlock all extra martial arts slots.

Street Walker
The first day 50.

Wily old bird
The first day 100.


2.	Updated English voice acting for the enemies.
We only updated the Chinese audio last week, so this week we have updated the English audio. We would like for English-speaking players to give their feedback! Currently, our entire game has complete English/Chinese audio.
3.	Updated English translation for events.
Last week, we prioritized the complete retranslation of the tutorial. This week we have updated the English translation for events.
4、Changed calculation of gaining/losing money from events.
According to player feedback on events, money deduction was deducted proportionally, which gave the impression of deliberately prolonging game time. We intended to make the game a bit challenging with some twists and turns along the way, instead of prolonging the game time.
That being said, adjustments were made this week to address this issue. We hope that players feel free to voice any comments or suggestions. We will definitely respond accordingly.
5．	Updated fight rewards to events and added a cancelation feature
Fights during events are supposed to be a fun addition, rather than a burden. So, we have added a prompt before combat which allows players to cancel the fight. We have also increased the amount of coins rewarded for combat.
6.	Updated character save data
Before starting the game, players can now see more data regarding their save file, such as: how long their character has lasted, the number of defeats, and what stage they are at.

Even though this isn’t a big update, we still would like to address problems players have had and provide a better gaming experience. Thank you everyone for your support!
